usage: Desktop category pills above the Modern vehicle search; not inventory photographs or mobile assets.

assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: small desktop automotive search category artwork, part of a matching four-vehicle set.
Style: premium, believable studio product photography with crisp silhouettes that remain readable at 88 by 48 CSS pixels.
Composition: one entire vehicle only, front three-quarter view, nose pointing toward the lower left, camera at wheel-to-headlight level. Wide landscape composition with the vehicle occupying about 88 percent of canvas width and tightly balanced top and bottom space. All wheels and mirrors fully visible, never cropped.
Lighting: soft neutral studio light, controlled highlights and a very faint contact shadow.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha, no floor, no scene, no enclosing shape.
Text: none.
Avoid: people, logos, lettering, badges, license plate text, watermark, colored glows, platforms, decorative shapes, cartoon styling, dramatic black shadows.
Subject: a modern premium graphite metallic passenger crossover SUV, sculpted bonnet, dark glass, silver alloy wheels, elegant and understated, generic design without visible manufacturer branding.
